In Hindu mythology, this name can be associated with Lord Vishnu who is believed to bestow grace and blessings upon his devotees. The name Istkhar carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Istkhar usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
